capabilities: Detect math in plain parentheses and single-line brackets
Convert quoted block math in blockquotes
Preserve code blocks, existing delimiters, links, and footnotes
Report conversion counts and support selection-only conversion
disambiguation: Not a math renderer or editor; it only rewrites the delimiters of already-written math content.
extras: Installation is manual from GitHub releases (manifest.json and main.js), not via the community plugin store; docs include tips on a related Obsidian paste setting and a fallback using the built-in Shift+$ wrapper.
intentEvidence: While there are other plugins for converting LaTeX delimiters, this one focuses on:
motivation: The author built it because pasted AI content needed each formula fixed by hand; one button fixes all math delimiters in a note automatically.
problem: AI assistants export math with \(…\) and \[…\] or bracket delimiters, which Obsidian does not render, forcing manual find-and-replace of every formula.

relations.evidence: When you copy content with mathematical formulas from ChatGPT, OpenWebUI, or other AI assistants

summary: Math delimiter converter that rewrites \[…\] and \(…\) LaTeX pasted from AI assistants into $$…$$ and $…$ Markdown math.
